claims.hypothesis: Is the kinematics of the cold gas strongly disturbed across the radio source or only in the centre?
claims.experiment: Velocity fields, position-velocity cut and velocity dispersion maps of CO(3-2), CO(1-0) and CO(2-1)
claims.result: FWZI ~600 km/s in the central beam; dispersion up to almost 100 km/s toward the N lobe and about 50 km/s just beyond
claims.finding: Kinematics strongly disturbed only in the central kpc and more weakly around the northern lobe

evidence.loc: abstract
evidence.quote: the kinematics of the cold molecular gas is strongly affected only in the central kpc, and it is more weakly affected around the northern lobe.

claims.hypothesis: Do CO line ratios reveal conditions affected by the radio jet?
claims.experiment: R32 and R21 maps from CO cubes matched in resolution, grids and mask
claims.result: R32 of 1.0 to 1.2 between core and N lobe; central R21 >~ 1.9; R32 above 0.6 up to ~5 kpc from the source
claims.finding: Extreme line ratios aligned with the radio axis indicate conditions different from undisturbed gas

evidence.loc: abstract
evidence.quote: the extreme line ratios of the CO transitions in a region that is aligned with the radio axis indicate conditions that are very different from those observed in the undisturbed gas at large radii.

claims.hypothesis: What does the CO(1-0) non-detection at the core imply?
claims.experiment: Compare CO profiles at the core position and derive a 3 sigma CO(1-0) upper limit
claims.result: No CO(1-0) at the core while CO(2-1) and CO(3-2) are clearly detected; limit of 39 mJy km/s
claims.finding: Extreme excitation conditions at the core location

evidence.loc: abstract
evidence.quote: The non-detection of CO(1-0) at the location of the core of the radio source implies extreme conditions at this location.

claims.hypothesis: Has a jet-cloud interaction removed molecular gas at the northern lobe?
claims.experiment: Channel maps of CO(3-2) overlaid with 262 GHz continuum; comparison of gas distribution with lobes
claims.result: Faint CO at the N lobe, with gas wrapped around the lobe at larger distances
claims.finding: Suggests a strong jet-cloud interaction depleted the northern lobe of gas, with a milder cocoon interaction nearby

evidence.loc: abstract
evidence.quote: This suggests that a strong jet-cloud interaction has depleted the northern lobe of molecular gas

claims.hypothesis: How much of the available AGN energy couples to the molecular gas?
claims.experiment: Outflow mass, rate and kinetic power upper limits compared with the jet power and with other sources
claims.result: Mdot < ~20 Msun/yr, Ekin < ~1e42 erg/s, well below the jet power of a few x 1e46 erg/s
claims.finding: Only a small fraction of the available energy is transferred to the ISM

evidence.loc: abstract
evidence.quote: the kinetic energy that is transferred to the interstellar medium is only a small fraction of the energy available from the AGN.

referee_caveats_inferred: Line-ratio uncertainties and beam-matching effects are not quantified; only 10% flux error is given
Outflow energetics are upper limits that depend on the assumed alpha_CO = 0.89 and a CO(3-2) line width for the CO(1-0) limit
Mask from CO(2-1) only may exclude CO(1-0) emission at other velocities, biasing the central R21 limit
Merger origin of the excitation is not ruled out, so attribution to the jet is partly inferred
